_note: The Cursor plugin's own MCP file (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json points at it). Cursor expands ${CURSOR_PLUGIN_ROOT} and, its docs say, deliberately does not expand the standard's ${PLUGIN_ROOT} — so the plugin root is spelled the Cursor way here. For the manual install (skills copied to ~/.agents/skills) use cursor.mcp.json instead, or run setup.py --harness cursor, which writes absolute paths. Both servers are local and read the key from the keys file written at registration, so an unexpanded ${env:...} is treated as no key rather than sent as one.
